# Repository guidance

- Read the repository documentation and existing code before proposing changes.
- Keep changes scoped to the request; do not introduce a framework, service, or architecture without an explicit need.
- Prefer small, reviewable patches and preserve existing conventions.
- Do not commit secrets, credentials, tokens, or personal data. Use documented environment-variable placeholders where configuration is required.
- Add or update focused tests when behavior changes, and report the commands run and their results.
- Call out assumptions, risks, and any verification that could not be completed.

For task context and durable decisions, follow the repository memory bank when it is present.
